BiblicalUsage: Haruz is named once, as the father of Meshullemeth, the mother of Amon king of Judah, a man of Jotbah. His daughter married into the royal house, and his name is kept in the record of Amon's reign.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a grandfather's name in a king's record is no accident: Haruz is there because God counts the family behind the throne.
